package.name: doa_mod
package.description:
dorai direction-of-arrival estimator. Captures the raw microphone-array channels, gates frames on voice activity, pools PHAT-weighted steered-response power across speech frames, and publishes the talker bearing in degrees (0-360) on /dorai_doa.
The estimator is doa_core.py, vendored byte-identical from the validated doa/ research tree: 6.1 deg mean absolute error over the eight marked positions of the 2026-08-12 hardware session. See README.md before changing the array geometry -- a mirrored channel map cannot be calibrated away.
